build_transformer: build a Transformer model for object detection with configurable encoder, decoder, and two-stage proposal generation
build_transformer_reparam: build a TransformerReParam model that uses delta-to-bbox conversion for reparameterized two-stage object detection
build_transformer_from_args: build a Transformer or TransformerReParam model from an args namespace using the build_transformer factory function
run_transformer_forward: run the Transformer forward pass with multi-scale source features, masks, and position embeddings to get decoder outputs
review_transformer_encoder_proposals: review the gen_encoder_output_proposals method that generates initial box proposals from encoder memory features
